expectations.text: Does not treat instructor letters or refundable reservations as authorized recurring sales
expectations.evidence: “They are nonbinding and establish no willingness to pay”; reservations are “weak evidence for an £80 monthly purchase”; “overlap and buyer authority are unknown.”

expectations.text: Distinguishes first assisted use from retention and notes the monthly repeat opportunity has not occurred
expectations.evidence: “None has reached its next monthly rota, so repeat use is untested—not a retention failure.”

expectations.text: Recommends a bounded next commitment rather than treating evidence as sufficient to hire two engineers
expectations.evidence: “Delay hiring the two engineers”; “set a small fixed test budget”; “positive pilot results should lead first to the smallest justified build”.

expectations.text: Chooses a test of buyer commitment or repeat value with eligible participants, measurement denominator and observation window
expectations.evidence: “Track all eight gyms through their next due date, including declines and nonresponses”; “For gyms that pay, observe the following monthly rota cycle.” Owners controlling spending receive the £80/month offer, and both the initial cohort and repeat eligible cohort are identified.

expectations.text: Includes an inconclusive outcome and labels any new threshold as a justified proposal rather than a universal benchmark
expectations.evidence: “These are proposed gates, not results already demonstrated; the supplied facts do not justify a precise conversion target or a hiring budget.” This appropriately qualifies gates, but no inconclusive outcome or treatment of unreached owners/not-yet-due cycles in the proposed decision rules is given. Conditional failure and success branches alone do not establish the requested third outcome.

expectations.text: Does not invent market facts, costs or profitable unit economics and stays within 700 body words
expectations.evidence: “Check whether £80 can cover realistic ongoing delivery and support”; “A warm pilot cohort cannot establish the cost of acquiring customers beyond the founder’s network”. No costs or profitable economics are asserted; supplied body count: 554, below 700.

unsupported_claims.evidence: The prompt establishes founder assistance but provides no amount or intensity. “Substantial” amplifies the supplied fact without support.
unsupported_claims.materiality: Potentially material to usability/support burden interpretation; the recommendation still correctly treats recurring paid value as untested.

suggestions.reason: Require decision rules to cover owners not reached, cycles not yet due, mixed conversion and incomplete observation, alongside a fixed resource/window cap. This memo has good measurement but no explicit inconclusive branch.
Add a check against invented intensity or necessity of assistance, which can mischaracterize feasibility and usability.

eval_feedback.overall: Judged only the anonymized memo and frozen case facts. No execution trace was supplied, so tool use or absence of browsing cannot be verified. All six assertions graded separately; compound requirements require every component.
